visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames including the 1024×640 summary. Gurk has tall twin pale square shafts over a stone west block, paired louver-backed belfry lights, shaft openings/quoins, north-west clock, flared caps, large bulbs, open lanterns, smaller upper bulbs and gilded finials. Long blue-grey basilica/aisle roofs meet a broad east choir and three unequal rounded stone apses with wide round blind arches, pilasters and narrow lights. Corrected the west entrance roof to a hip/small dormer, widened and rounded the apse arcades, adjusted pale stone tint and subdivided broad faces to contain replacement-footprint rasterization. Fine masonry/clock/finial ornament is simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic frames. Geographic views use flat terrain; portable views retain standard viewer DEM.
